name: Reeleezee
description: Reeleezee (Exact Reeleezee) online accounting for Dutch businesses: administrations, chart of accounts, column balance, balance sheet, profit and loss, sales and purchase invoices, offerings, customers, vendors, products, bank statements and transactions. Creates customers and draft sales invoices. Sign-in with your Reeleezee login.

REELEEZEE_USERNAME.label: Reeleezee user name
REELEEZEE_USERNAME.help: The user name you sign in to Reeleezee with. A separate user with only the rights the assistant needs is recommended.
REELEEZEE_USERNAME.patternMessage: Enter the Reeleezee user name without spaces or a colon.

REELEEZEE_PASSWORD.label: Reeleezee password
REELEEZEE_PASSWORD.help: The password of that Reeleezee user.

REELEEZEE_ADMINISTRATION_ID.label: Default administration id
REELEEZEE_ADMINISTRATION_ID.help: Optional. The GUID of the administration the assistant works in. Leave empty at first, ask the assistant to list your administrations and paste the id here.
REELEEZEE_ADMINISTRATION_ID.patternMessage: Enter the administration id as a GUID, e.g. 7f9c2a34-5b1d-4e8a-9c0f-2d6a1b3e4f50.

instructionFacts: The default administration of this workspace has the id {{REELEEZEE_ADMINISTRATION_ID}}: pass it as administration_id unless the user names another administration.

verifyHints.401: Reeleezee refused the sign-in. Check the user name and password: they are the ones of the Reeleezee web application.
verifyHints.403: This Reeleezee user has no rights for that administration or function. Ask the administration owner to widen the rights of the user.
verifyHints.404: Reeleezee found nothing there. Check the administration id and the record id: both are GUIDs and a record belongs to one administration.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Reeleezee allows 60 calls per minute and one call at a time per login. Wait a minute and call the tools one after another.

prerequisites: A Reeleezee (Exact Reeleezee) account and a user name and password that can open the administration. No API key or app registration is needed. About 2 minutes.
instructions:
## Reeleezee
This connector works with the **Reeleezee REST API** (Exact Reeleezee, Dutch online accounting) at `https://portal.reeleezee.nl/api/v1`: administrations, periods, the chart of accounts, column balance, balance sheet and profit and loss, journal lines, sales invoices, offerings, purchase invoices, customers, vendors, products, VAT rates, payment accounts, bank statements and bank transactions. It can create customers with their address and draft sales invoices.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. Use a Reeleezee login that can open the administration: the API takes the same user name and password as the Reeleezee web application (HTTP Basic). A separate user with only the rights the assistant needs is recommended.
2. Enter the user name in `REELEEZEE_USERNAME` and the password in `REELEEZEE_PASSWORD`.
3. Optional: after the first `reeleezee_list_administrations`, put the id of the administration you work in into `REELEEZEE_ADMINISTRATION_ID`, so the assistant does not have to look it up in every chat.

**Where to start**: `reeleezee_list_administrations` gives the administrations of the login; `reeleezee_get_administration` shows one. Every other tool needs `administration_id`. `reeleezee_list_periods` gives the period ids for the financial reports.

**Ledger and reports**: `reeleezee_list_ledger_accounts` and `reeleezee_get_ledger_account` (grootboekrekeningen), `reeleezee_get_column_balance` (kolommenbalans), `reeleezee_get_balance_sheet`, `reeleezee_get_profit_and_loss`, `reeleezee_get_ledger_balance` for one account, and `reeleezee_list_journal_entry_lines` for the booked lines. The report tools take `start_period` and `end_period` (period ids, not dates).

**Sales**: `reeleezee_list_sales_invoices`, `reeleezee_get_sales_invoice`, `reeleezee_list_sales_invoice_lines`; offerings (quotes) with `reeleezee_list_offerings`, `reeleezee_get_offering` and `reeleezee_list_offering_lines`. Status is 1 tentative (draft), 2 open, 3 closed. `reeleezee_save_sales_invoice_draft` writes a draft only: booking, numbering and sending stay in Reeleezee.

**Purchases**: `reeleezee_list_purchase_invoices`, `reeleezee_get_purchase_invoice`, `reeleezee_list_purchase_invoice_lines`.

**Relations and products**: `reeleezee_list_customers`, `reeleezee_get_customer`, `reeleezee_list_vendors`, `reeleezee_get_vendor`, `reeleezee_list_products`, `reeleezee_list_tax_rates`. Create or change a customer with `reeleezee_save_customer` and its address with `reeleezee_save_customer_address`.

**Banking**: `reeleezee_list_payment_accounts` (bank and cash accounts with their balance), `reeleezee_list_bank_statements` and `reeleezee_list_bank_transactions`. All read-only: the connector never starts a payment, a direct debit or a bank export.

**Creating records**: Reeleezee creates with PUT on an id the client chooses. Generate a random GUID (UUID v4, e.g. `7f9c2a34-5b1d-4e8a-9c0f-2d6a1b3e4f50`) for every new customer, address, communication channel and invoice, and use each GUID once. Whether a PUT keeps the fields you leave out is not documented: after an update compare the answer with the record you read before. Nothing is deleted by this connector.

**OData**: list tools answer `value` (the rows) and accept `filter`, `select`, `orderby`, `top` and `skip` (OData v4). Records are wide, so use `select`. Dates in a filter are written `2026-01-31T00:00:00Z` without quotes, text in single quotes, GUIDs without quotes; if a filter is refused, read a few rows first and filter on the fields and value forms you see. Page with `skip`: the `@odata.nextLink` of an answer can point to another host and cannot be followed by these tools.

**Limits and pitfalls**: at most 60 calls per minute. One login cannot run two calls at the same time: call the tools one after another, never in parallel, or Reeleezee answers that the login is in use. Three failed writes within a minute block the login for 10 minutes, so do not retry a refused save unchanged. All ids are GUIDs. Amounts are decimals; Base amounts are in the administration currency. Dates come back as `2026-01-31T00:00:00`. Field names and many values are Dutch bookkeeping terms (debiteur is customer, crediteur is vendor, grootboek is ledger, offerte is offering).

tools.name: reeleezee_list_administrations
tools.description: List the administrations (sets of books) this login can open: id, Name, AdminType, Status, CreateDate, TestAdministration, Deleted and HasAdministrationAccess. The id is the administration_id of every other tool. Read-only.

filter.description: OData v4 $filter, e.g. `Deleted eq false`. Operators eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, and, or; functions such as contains(Field,'text').

select.description: OData $select: comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `id,Name,Status,CreateDate`. Use it: records have many fields.

orderby.description: OData $orderby: a field name followed by asc or desc, e.g. `Name asc`.

skip.description: Rows to skip for paging: raise it by top until fewer than top rows come back.

Read-only.

tools.name: reeleezee_save_customer
tools.description: Create a customer, or update one, with PUT on its id. For a new customer generate a random GUID (UUID v4) yourself and pass it as customer_id; for an update pass the id of the existing customer. Returns the saved customer. Add a postal address with reeleezee_save_customer_address. Show the user what will be saved and wait for confirmation.

administration_id.description: Administration id, a GUID (id of reeleezee_list_administrations).

customer_id.description: A new random GUID (UUID v4) for a new customer, or the id of the customer to update.

name.description: Customer name (company name, or full name of a person).

search_name.description: Short name used in lists and searches. Default: use the name.

additional_name.description: Second name line, e.g. a department.

due_days.description: Payment term in days for invoices to this customer.

communication_channels.description: E-mail and phone entries, each with its own new GUID: `[{"id": "0b5d7c1e-3f1a-4a7e-9c55-2f6f0d1c8a11", "CommunicationType": 10, "FormattedValue": "info@example.nl"}]`. CommunicationType: 9 telephone, 10 e-mail, 11 fax, 12 website, 13 mobile phone.

extra_fields.description: Other Customer fields by their API name, e.g. `{"FirstName": "Jan", "LastName": "Jansen", "ChamberOfCommerceCity": "Utrecht"}`. The named parameters of this tool win over the same field here.

tools.name: reeleezee_save_customer_address
tools.description: Add an address to a customer, or update one, with PUT on its id. For a new address generate a random GUID (UUID v4) and pass it as address_id. Returns the saved address. Invoices to the customer use its billing address.

administration_id.description: Administration id, a GUID (id of reeleezee_list_administrations).

address_id.description: A new random GUID (UUID v4) for a new address, or the id of the address to update (AddressList of reeleezee_get_customer).

type.description: Address type: 1 office, 2 billing (default), 3 shipping, 4 home.

street.description: Street name without the house number.

number_extension.description: House number addition, e.g. A or bis.

extra_fields.description: Other Address fields by their API name, e.g. `{"PObox": "123", "BuildingName": "Toren A"}`.

tools.name: reeleezee_save_sales_invoice_draft
tools.description: Create a draft (tentative) sales invoice for a customer with PUT on its id: generate a random GUID (UUID v4) yourself and pass it as invoice_id. Returns the saved invoice with its totals. The draft is not booked, numbered or sent: the user checks and books it in Reeleezee. Show the user the customer, lines and amounts and wait for confirmation.

administration_id.description: Administration id, a GUID (id of reeleezee_list_administrations).

invoice_id.description: A new random GUID (UUID v4) for the new invoice, or the id of a draft to replace.

due_date.description: Payment due date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the payment term of the customer.

reference.description: Reference, e.g. the customer's order number.

is_vat_included.description: true: line prices include VAT. Default false.

Price.description: Price per unit in the invoice currency.

TaxRate.description: VAT rate as `{"id": "<tax rate id>"}` (id of reeleezee_list_tax_rates).

Account.description: Revenue ledger as `{"id": "<ledger id>"}` (id of reeleezee_list_ledger_accounts).

extra_fields.description: Other SalesInvoice fields by their API name, e.g. `{"Description": "Project Alfa", "DiscountPercentage": 5}`.
